request: ENNI is an English narrative-speech dataset from the CHILDES Clinical English Edmonton Narrative Norms Instrument corpus, comprising recordings from Canadian children with typical development (286) or specific language impairment (66). The task is picture-elicited story generation, in which participants narrate a picture story to an examiner. Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: formant_lpc: The user requests anonymization of English narrative recordings, explicitly skips run_mask, and asks to compare all methods. Based on historical results, particularly the English ADReSS task, pitch and formant_spec can preserve downstream performance while Resyn may remove subtle acoustic cues. Run formant_lpc, formant_spec, pitch, NeuralVC, and Resyn in sequence, followed by evaluation. Set with_mask to false for each conversion.
